I replied to Pree in her #central-random thread to confirm the correction: the Tansley Parcel deadline for the signed order form is 3 April, not the date she posted in #central-team this morning. The reply also offered to post a correction in #central-team if she wants one.

As she asked, I did nothing else. A deadline date is an operational fact rather than a finance figure, and she had already posted it herself, so it was fine to repeat in the channel.
